seed: Shannon Byrne Susko, Circle post Foundation Year: Q-1 (Quarter 1 checklist), Metronomics. Confirm and evolve.

slides.title: Is your Function Chart still right?
slides.headline: Is your Function Chart still right?
notes: Put the current Function Chart on the screen. Ask where ownership was unclear last quarter, then fix the chart.
Allow about 25 minutes, with the Team View after it.
slides.support: Test it against how the quarter really went.
body: Every function has one owner who said yes out loud.
New or planned functions are on the chart.

slides.title: Does your Core Purpose still hold?
slides.headline: Does your Core Purpose still hold?
notes: Change only what needs changing. Allow 5 to 10 minutes.
slides.support: Read it aloud. Is it still true? What changes?

slides.title: Do your Core Values still hold?
slides.headline: Do your Core Values still hold?
notes: If the team has no Core Values yet, skip this slide.
Change only what needs changing. Allow 5 to 10 minutes.
slides.support: If you have Core Values, read them aloud and test each one:
body: Is it a value you hire and fire on, or a brand value?
When did you last let someone go for not living it?
Does someone who keeps breaking it belong here?
Would you build a new company around it, in any industry?
